description.value: HiFive Chicken is a Canadian fast food chain founded in Vancouver in 2016, now operating over 11 locations across British Columbia. The Burnaby Kingsway location serves freshly marinated fried and roasted chicken in various preparations — whole pieces, sandwiches, tenders, wings, and boxed meals — made with in-house sauces and special ingredients. The chain's loyalty app and e-gift cards add a modern convenience layer for regulars and travelers alike.
